questions.question: A fully managed object storage service offering industry-leading scalability, data availability, and security. It stores any amount of data from anywhere and is the backbone of many AWS data workflows.
A block storage service that provides persistent, high-performance volumes for use with Amazon EC2 instances. Volumes persist independently from the running life of an instance.
A fully managed, scalable shared file storage service (NFS protocol) that can be mounted on multiple EC2 instances simultaneously and grows and shrinks automatically as you add and remove files.
A low-cost cloud storage service for data archiving. It provides three retrieval options from milliseconds to hours, making it ideal for long-term backup and compliance archives.
A managed service that provides fully managed third-party high-performance file systems on AWS, including options for Windows file shares, Lustre (HPC), NetApp ONTAP, and OpenZFS.
A hybrid cloud storage service that gives your on-premises applications seamless access to virtually unlimited cloud storage. It connects on-premises software appliances to cloud-based storage.
A centralized service to automate backup of data across AWS services, letting you define backup policies and monitor backup activity from a single place across your entire organization.
